{{Top|canon=Republic Era}}
{{Otheruses|Republic Era}}
{{Quote|There is no peace. What we thought was the Great Peace of the Republic was only a dream from which our galaxy has now awakened. I doubt we'll ever fall back into any dream like that again. In the Galaxy of War, no one sleeps that well.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], ''[[The Private Journals of Mace Windu]]''|<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>}}
The '''Great Peace of the Republic''' was a [[Time/Legends|time]] period that lasted from the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Battle of Ruusan]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> that began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> This peace ended when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared war on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].
